input.quote: Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Client; Section 2(a) expressly preserves our freedom to build, buy or license competing software, subject only to standard IP and confidentiality limits. We note Section 8(d) refers to a separate Non-Competition Agreement, which should be reviewed on its own terms but imposes nothing in this document.

input.quote: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Client; the licence is non-exclusive and Section 2(a) confirms Client may source similar software and services elsewhere. Nothing in Sections 2, 5 or 8 requires us to host or procure exclusively through TrueLink.

input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only MFN runs in our favour — TrueLink's hosting rates may not exceed those charged to any other customer. No obligation requires Client to extend best terms to TrueLink, so no redline.

A full-text search for solicitation, hiring and inducement language returns only the unsolicited-e-mail provisions in Section 7; neither the Client covenants in Section 8 nor the confidentiality provisions in Section 10 contain a non-solicit or no-hire binding Client. This matches our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
